verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an official MCP server that any MCP-capable agent can connect to. It has a dedicated configuration guide and a concepts page describing what agents can do with live telemetry: investigate latency and error spikes, find outliers, and translate dashboards. A probe also confirms the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, detailed evidence of the exposed tool list and auth setup.
